contract.atomicFactSet: 精确公开Delivery Fence的target_not_current + opaque read fence + Arca域内无Accepted Decision/Attempt/Custody复核 + immutable Offer Withdrawal Receipt + 可选当前Recovery Case停止调度投影 + Command Receipt/marker/Audit；不伪造Acceptance Rejection、不转移或释放Control、不修改历史Assessment或Libra包；重复消息消费同一Receipt，已Accepted责任禁止关闭；`hasOutbox=false`
